reviews.t: I am in California and saw on YouTube how this church is serving their community after hurricane Helene with supplies, hot meals, warm attitudes. What a blessing! This is what church should look like and if more did, a lot more people would know God’s love and have faith. Props to y’all.

Watching this church respond to Hurricane Helene was pretty devastating for my family. Church folk wanted anyone volunteering with relief efforts to sign a waiver promising to preach about Christianity as they passed out food, water and supplies. Ew. Helicopters dropping off supplies for all and church men telling neighbors they couldn't help unless they talked about jesus while they distributed... this church is not to be trusted with our community

We went to the easter egg hunt and the kids enjoyed it. We have friends that attend and enjoy it and even just recently returned from a mission trip to Guatemala. The church looks to be doing many get things in the faith as well as in the community. And also with the youth they will have vacation bible school coming up in July. Also the church building itself is just beautiful.
The people I have met here really care about their community. They are full of love, joy, grace, and most importantly, the Holy Spirit.
We use the facilities for a homeschool co-op and the staff and volunteers there have bent over backwards to make sure we were welcome and had anything we needed. So thankful for this ministry.
My family was first time there for women's banquet. We have free clothes, shoes, books & haircuts 💇 & etc. And dinner so good yummy. 💜😘 …
This is an amazing church, with amazing leadership and volunteers, doing an amazing work!
Very Nice. Comfortable atmosphere. Pastor gave a nice service and message.
Very friendly people and Bible based Godly church.
very good preahing could have been friendly good music I would go back
